title_zh: 凝心聚力把强国建设、民族复兴的宏伟蓝图变成美好现实——习近平总书记在庆祝中华人民共和国成立77周年招待会上的重要讲话引发热烈反响
title_en: Xi Jinping's Speech at the Reception Marking the 77th Anniversary of the Founding of the People's Republic of China Draws Warm Response
summary_zh: 2026年10月，习近平总书记在庆祝中华人民共和国成立77周年招待会上发表重要讲话，各界反响热烈，表示要凝心聚力把强国建设、民族复兴的宏伟蓝图变成美好现实。
summary_en: In October 2026, Xi Jinping delivered an important speech at the reception celebrating the 77th anniversary of the founding of the People's Republic of China, drawing warm responses from all sectors committed to turning the blueprint for national strength and rejuvenation into reality.
